name: Corporate Action Option
definition: Provides information about the alternatives available to an account owner when participating to a corporate action event. This is defined at a general level without looking at the specificities of the securities balances.

OptionNumber.name: Option Number
OptionNumber.definition: Number identifying the available corporate action options.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Type of corporate action options available to the account owner.

FractionDisposition.name: Fraction Disposition
FractionDisposition.definition: Treatment of the fractions resulting from derived securities will be processed or how prorated decisions will be rounding, if provided with a pro ration rate.

CurrencyOption.name: Currency Option
CurrencyOption.definition: Currency choice given to the investor.

OptionFeatures.name: Option Features
OptionFeatures.definition: Features that may apply to a corporate action option.

OfferType.name: Offer Type
OfferType.definition: Conditions that apply to the offer.

ChargesAppliedIndicator.name: Charges Applied Indicator
ChargesAppliedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether charges apply to the holder, for instance redemption charges.

WithdrawalAllowedIndicator.name: Withdrawal Allowed Indicator
WithdrawalAllowedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether withdrawal of instruction is allowed.

ChangeAllowedIndicator.name: Change Allowed Indicator
ChangeAllowedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether change of instruction is allowed.

Default.name: Default
Default.definition: Specifies whether the option is the default option or not.

ProrationBelowMinimumQuantity.name: Proration Below Minimum Quantity
ProrationBelowMinimumQuantity.definition: Specifies how instructions prorated below the minimum quantity to instruct will be processed.

RelatedChoiceCorporateAction.name: Related Choice Corporate Action
RelatedChoiceCorporateAction.definition: Corporate action for which one or more options are provided.

CorporateActionElection.name: Corporate Action Election
CorporateActionElection.definition: Election process which selected a specific option.

ActionPeriod.name: Action Period
ActionPeriod.definition: Period during which the specified option remains valid, eg, offer period.

CorporateActionOptionServicing.name: Corporate Action Option Servicing
CorporateActionOptionServicing.definition: Calculation of the entitlement on the basis of the proposed option.

ProceedsDefinition.name: Proceeds Definition
ProceedsDefinition.definition: Definition of exchanges of cash and / or securities available in the processing of corporate actions.

Distribution.name: Distribution
Distribution.definition: Distribution process for which an option is selected.
